summary: Yorkville International Capital Corp. filed an 8-K to report the closing of its IPO of 23,000,000 units at $10.00/unit, including full exercise of the underwriters' over-allotment, raising $230,000,000 in gross proceeds. Simultaneously, the sponsor and underwriter purchased 6,300,000 private placement warrants at $1.00 each, generating $6,300,000. Proceeds were deposited into a trust account, standard for blank-check companies. The audited balance sheet is included as an exhibit. As a newly formed SPAC (SIC 6770), the company has 24 months to complete a business combination. Watch for target announcement and shareholder vote; risk-arb centers on deal certainty and redemption risk.
